gatoh.graphs.graphs.GraphSet.get_index

GraphSet.get_index(hierarchy: str) → int[source]

A getter function that returns the index of a given hierarchy within the GraphSet.

Parameters:

hierarchy (str) – The name of the hierarchy that is being searched for.

Raises:

KeyError – If the input hierarchy does not exist within the GraphSet.

Returns:

The index of the hierarchy within the GraphSet.

Return type:

int
